_meta.description: ADR-037 register fragment declaring the Titel 9 Boek 2 BW jaarrekening (annual financial statement) data model: AnnualReport, BalanceSheet, IncomeStatement, CashFlowStatement, Note, DirectorReport and ReviewWorkflow. Schema-declared per ADR-031 (lifecycle/RBAC/relations as metadata, no parallel service classes per ADR-022). The exact rubriek codes per art. 2:373 & 2:377 BW are stored as data; GL-to-rubriek mapping is configuration (lib/Settings/seeds/).

AnnualReport.title: Annual Report
AnnualReport.description: Titel 9 Boek 2 BW jaarrekening root record for one administration and one boekjaar. Carries the computed groottecategorie with its onderbouwing, the rapportagegrondslag, valuta, and the concept -> opgemaakt -> in-review -> vastgesteld -> gedeponeerd lifecycle with its wettelijke termijnen. The constituent documents (BalanceSheet, IncomeStatement, CashFlowStatement, Note, DirectorReport) reference this record by reportId. Groottecategorie is computed, not operator-selectable (design D1); the report becomes an immutable snapshot at opmaak (design D2). No AnnualReportService PHP class; generation is templated per ADR-022/ADR-031.

sizeCategory.title: Groottecategorie

criteriaMatched.title: Criteria Matched

sizeCategorySubstantiation.title: Groottecategorie Onderbouwing

rapportageBasis.title: Rapportage Grondslag

status.title: Status

snapshotHash.title: Snapshot Hash

auditorsStatementRequired.description: True when an accountantsverklaring is wettelijk verplicht (middelgroot+).
auditorsStatementRequired.title: Accountantsverklaring Vereist

cashFlowStatementRequired.description: True for middelgroot+ where a kasstroomoverzicht is verplicht.
cashFlowStatementRequired.title: Kasstroomoverzicht Vereist

boardReportRequired.description: True for middelgroot+ where a bestuursverslag is verplicht.
boardReportRequired.title: Bestuursverslag Vereist

boardMembers.description: Names of the bestuursleden who sign the opmaak.
boardMembers.title: Bestuur Leden

shareholdersJSONB.description: Shareholder structure snapshot relevant to disclosure (free-form per administration).
shareholdersJSONB.title: Aandeelhouders Jsonb

decisionRef.description: Decidesk Decision id for the AV/board adoption. Written only by the decidesk registry callback.
decisionRef.title: Decision Ref

decisionOutcome.description: Mirror of the adoption Decision outcome. The vaststellen transition is OUTCOME-DRIVEN: fires only when decisionOutcome==approved.
decisionOutcome.title: Decision Outcome

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Earliest form; balans/V&W recalculate as the GL changes. Editable.

opgemaakt.label: Opgemaakt door bestuur
opgemaakt.description: Bestuur-signed; an immutable snapshot is taken and all figures freeze (design D2).

in-review.label: In review (accountant)
in-review.description: Under accountant review. Bestuur source data is read-only until the review is cancelled.

determined.label: Vastgesteld door AV
determined.description: Approved by the algemene vergadering; final snapshot frozen; deponering activated.

gedeponeerd.label: Gedeponeerd bij KVK
gedeponeerd.description: Filed at KVK via SBR-XBRL; immutable final state.

opmaken.label: Opmaken door bestuur
opmaken.description: Bestuur signs the concept; an immutable snapshot is created (design D2). Requires the balans to balance (activa = passiva).

naarReview.label: Indienen voor accountantscontrole
naarReview.description: Submit the opgemaakte jaarrekening to the accountant. Bestuur source data becomes read-only.

reviewAnnuleren.label: Review annuleren
reviewAnnuleren.description: Cancel the review to re-open bestuur editing. The accountant change-log is retained.

vaststellenZonderReview.label: Vaststellen door AV
vaststellenZonderReview.description: AV approves directly where no accountantsverklaring is verplicht (klein/micro). OUTCOME-DRIVEN: requires adoption decisionOutcome==approved from decidesk.

vaststellen.label: Vaststellen na review
vaststellen.description: AV approves after accountant sign-off; an accountantsverklaring MUST be attached for middelgroot+. OUTCOME-DRIVEN: requires adoption decisionOutcome==approved from decidesk.

deponeren.label: Deponeren bij KVK
deponeren.description: Hand the final AnnualReport snapshot to bookkeeping-sbr-xbrl-reporting for SBR-XBRL conversion and Digipoort submission.

actions.description: Emit a CloudEvent consumed by bookkeeping-sbr-xbrl-reporting to convert the snapshot to SBR-XBRL and submit via Digipoort. Cross-module integration point; no PHP orchestration here (ADR-022).

subject.en: Annual report adopted by the general meeting

BalanceSheet.title: Balance Sheet
BalanceSheet.description: Balans conforming to art. 2:373 BW. Activa split into vaste activa (B.I immaterieel, B.II materieel, B.III financieel) and vlottende activa (C.I voorraden, C.II vorderingen, C.III effecten, C.IV liquide middelen); passiva split into A eigen vermogen, B voorzieningen, C langlopende schulden, D kortlopende schulden. Each rubriek carries huidigJaar, vorigJaar (comparatief) and footnote references. GL-to-rubriek mapping is configuration (lib/Settings/seeds/balans-rubriek-mapping.json), not code (design D3).

totalAssets.description: Computed total assets. MUST equal totalPassiva (balans balances).
totalAssets.title: Total Activa

totalLiabilities.description: Computed total liabilities + equity. MUST equal totalActiva.
totalLiabilities.title: Total Passiva

rubrieckCode.title: Rubrieck Code

side.title: Zijde

notes.title: Notes

IncomeStatement.title: Income Statement
IncomeStatement.description: Winst-en-verliesrekening per art. 2:377 BW. Model A 'categorisch' groups costs by type; Model E 'functioneel' groups costs by function. Model choice must be consistent year-on-year; a change is a stelselwijziging disclosure. Subtotals (bedrijfsresultaat, resultaat voor belasting, nettoresultaat) are computed. The model rubriek catalogue is configuration (lib/Settings/seeds/vw-model-rubrieken.json), not code.

model.description: V&W model per art. 2:377 BW. A: costs by type; E: costs by function.
model.title: Model

netResult.description: Computed net result for the boekjaar.
netResult.title: Nettoresultaat

position.title: Position

rubrieckCode.title: Rubrieck Code

notes.title: Notes

rubrieken.title: Rubrieken

CashFlowStatement.title: Cash Flow Statement
CashFlowStatement.description: Kasstroomoverzicht per RJ 350. Mandatory only for middelgroot+; klein/micro may prepare voluntarily. Indirect method is default (nettoresultaat + afschrijvingen + mutaties werkkapitaal); direct method optional. Three categories (operationeel, investering, financiering) reconcile to the change in liquide middelen on the balans.

method.description: Cash flow method per RJ 350. Indirect is the SME default (design D5).
method.title: Method

status.description: draft while draft; final once opgemaakt.
status.title: Status

operationalCashFlow.description: Net cash flow from operating activities.
operationalCashFlow.title: Operationele Kasstroom

investmentCashFlow.description: Net cash flow from investing activities.
investmentCashFlow.title: Investerings Kasstroom

financingCashFlow.description: Net cash flow from financing activities.
financingCashFlow.title: Financierings Kasstroom

netMovementCashEquivalents.description: Reconciling net change in cash; MUST match the balans liquide-middelen delta.
netMovementCashEquivalents.title: Netto Mutatie Geldmiddelen

rules.description: Per-category line items (e.g. afschrijvingen, mutatie vorderingen, investeringen, aflossing, dividend).
rules.title: Regels

Note.title: Toelichting Note
Note.description: An individual toelichting-paragraaf (accounting note) per art. 2:381-388 BW and the RJ guidelines. Each note carries its volgorde, code, title, structured content, the wettelijke basis (RJ guideline / wetsartikel) and the template that generated it. Mandatory notes per groottecategorie come from lib/Settings/seeds/toelichting-templates.json (design D4).

code.description: Note reference code linking from balans/V&W rubrieken (e.g. Note 1.2).
code.title: Code

contentJSONB.description: Structured content: rich-text narrative and/or table rows (MVA-verloop, EV-matrix, schulden-tabel) per the template contentType (design D4).
contentJSONB.title: Content Jsonb

statutoryBasis.description: Wettelijke/RJ basis for the note (e.g. 'RJ 212 Materiële vaste activa', 'RJ 240 Eigen vermogen', 'Art. 2:382 Niet-uit-balans-verplichtingen').
statutoryBasis.title: Wettelijke Basis

generatedBy.description: Name of the toelichting-template that generated this note (design D4).
generatedBy.title: Gegenereerd Door

mandatory.description: True when this note is wettelijk verplicht for the report's groottecategorie.
mandatory.title: Verplicht

DirectorReport.title: Director Report
DirectorReport.description: Bestuursverslag per art. 2:391 BW, mandatory for middelgroot+. A separate entity from AnnualReport (design D8) so it can be versioned and signed independently. Sections (algemeen, financiële-gang, risico's, toekomst, personeel, milieu, optional r-d and esg) carry auto-populated context plus operator narrative.

status.description: draft while authored; completed when ready for opmaak.
status.title: Status

name.description: Section identifier. r-d and esg are optional.
name.title: Name

autoPopulatedFields.description: Auto-populated context (e.g. omzetYoYDelta, margineTrend, gemiddeldAantalWerknemers) provided by the template (design D7).
autoPopulatedFields.title: Auto Populated Fields

ReviewWorkflow.title: Review Workflow
ReviewWorkflow.description: Accountant-review workflow for a jaarrekening. A strict linear progression (design D6): concept -> in-review -> vastgesteld -> gedeponeerd, with per-step assignee, status and an immutable comment/handover log. During in-review the bestuur cannot edit source data without cancelling (enforced via AnnualReportGuard). The accountantsverklaring attaches at the in-review -> vastgesteld boundary.

reportId.description: FK to the AnnualReport under review.
reportId.title: Report ID

currentStap.description: Current workflow step mirroring the AnnualReport status (design D6).
currentStap.title: Huidig Stap

assignee.description: User assigned to this step (e.g. the accountant).
assignee.title: Assignee

location.description: Where the comment applies (e.g. 'Balans rubriek B.II').
location.title: Locatie

rationale.description: Reason, required when status is afgewezen.
rationale.title: Motivatie
